author: Alexc2510
quote: The perfect game remade, what more could you ask for? the gameplay innovated games to this day, the music is a masterpiece, the dungeons are amazing, the story and narrative is fantastic, Link is the pure-hearted main character we all love and the side characters all have amazing dialogue. A MASTERPIECE!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Alexc2510
quote: only positive thing about this game is the detailed graphics and immersive world, other than that the game in every other regard is a mess, it's filled with bugs, lacks story, character personality, the game doesn't feel like a gta whatsoever, it feels like a life simulator. This game only elevates the reception and respect of the gta games of old because this fall off needs to be studied.
